'''Shondra Del''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who operated in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Shondra Del was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and she made a living as a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], operating within the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. Following the outbreak of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Del joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and she was tasked with handling the Alliance's operations in the Elrood [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. She established Rebel cells and supplied goods to the [[Friends of Paran]] resistance group, leading the Friends of Paran to consider affiliating themselves with the Alliance. Del also came into contact with the [[Khuiumin Survivors]], a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Jacob Nive]], and she met with them on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korad]]. However, the pirates had been tracked by agents of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and the Survivors were captured. Del fled off-world to planet [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]], but she was pursued by ISB agents and captured. She was taken by the Empire to the planet [[Derilyn]] and was sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] by combat in the [[Arena of Games]], an amphitheater in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tekar]] that was operated by the Imperial planetary [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Afren Hul]]. However, Del was rescued from the area by the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Mikos Argdran]] and a team of Rebel agents. Del and the agents subsequently traveled to the [[Friends of Paran base]] in the city [[Knellis]], and a short time later she assisted with a Friends of Paran mission to infiltrate the [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]] and [[Battle of Derilyn|destroy]] the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Brazen]]''. After that mission, Del sent a message to the Rebel agents congratulating them, and suggested it was likely she'd work with them again.
